quote: We calculate the accuracy of the predicted answers from LLMs and focus on the average performance (Avg.)

We calculate the accuracy of the predicted answers from LLMs and focus on the average performance (Avg.), since our major goal is building a multi-lingual LLM. Moreover, we introduce the incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) to assess the efficiency of the approaches.

We calculate the accuracy of the predicted answers from LLMs and focus on the average performance (Avg.), since our major goal is building a multi-lingual LLM. Moreover, we introduce the incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER)  to assess the efficiency of the approaches, i.e., ICER = #Tokens / Improvement ×100%.
